data.why: One house on the lawn, its gable open to the camera so the attic shows; the roof is built layer by layer and the rain is followed down it. The camera opens close on the plywood, goes into the attic for the drips, follows the rain down the slope to the gutter and the downspout, and ends on the whole house.

ideas.idea: water drips through the seams onto the attic floor
a dark sheet rolls over the plywood
the sheet's lower edge flaps up
overlapping shingles shed the water downhill
water drips inside beside the chimney
a metal collar seals the chimney
rain pours off the edge into a puddle by the wall
a gutter catches the water at the eave
water spills over the gutter's lip
a downspout carries the water away from the wall
the leaf washes out of the downspout into the grass
the finished roof in the sun

chain.shows: water drips through the seams into the attic
the wind lifts and rips the sheet
water runs into the crack at the chimney
rain pours off the edge into a puddle by the wall

surprises.claim: Roofing underlayment is a water-resistant sheet laid over the roof deck under the shingles.
surprises.search: roofing underlayment water resistant layer over roof deck under shingles

surprises.claim: Shingle rows overlap so each row covers the joints of the row below.
surprises.search: asphalt shingle courses overlap offset joints row below

surprises.claim: Chimney flashing is bent metal that seals the joint where the chimney meets the roof.
surprises.search: chimney flashing metal step counter flashing seals roof joint

surprises.claim: Downspouts should carry roof water several feet away from the foundation.
surprises.search: downspout extension discharge feet away from foundation

sentences.text: If you nail plywood over your house, you have a roof.
But rain sneaks between the sheets into the attic.
So you roll a waterproof sheet over the wood.
But wind catches the sheet's edge and rips it up.
So you lay overlapping shingles on top.
But the water runs into the crack at the chimney.
So you tuck metal flashing around the bricks.
But past the flashing, rain puddles by the wall.
So you hang a gutter under the edge.
But the full gutter spills over its side.
So a downspout carries it out into the yard.
Now the rain runs off your house into the grass.
Congratulations, you have built a roof.
